pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   D. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   C. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   C. Say Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
